editorIntro: A confirmed Red Hill market, a free Saturday acoustic set at Moonah Links, and an exhibition open both days at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

picks.editorVerdict: Local produce and makers at Red Hill Recreation Reserve on Saturday, 9am–2pm. Check the organiser for unsafe-weather cancellations before travelling.
Free acoustic music at Moonah Links on Saturday, 5–8pm. No booking required; settle in after a day exploring the Peninsula.
MPRG hosts National Works on Paper 2026 through 22 November. Open Saturday and Sunday, 11am–4pm, for an all-weather art stop.
